propositions: Four rendered advanced parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stock argparse.HelpFormatter instead of version-pinned RebarHelpFormatter, creating a py3.13 help-rendering regression risk identical to the one S2d fixed for bridge.

Help artifacts generated by gen_cli_help.py from these four factories are width-78 (stdlib default) while bridge.txt is width-80 (RebarHelpFormatter), creating inconsistency within the same command family.

Short+long option metavar rendering and subparser usage wrapping diverge between py3.11/3.12 and py3.13 in stdlib argparse, causing gen_cli_help.py --check to fail silently on py3.13 if these routes gain affected constructs.
Contract test must enforce that all help-backed (rendered) routes use RebarHelpFormatter, preventing reintroduction of the trap after fix.
